Ask any superstar if their first years were balanced. They laugh.

Kevin Trudeau points to athletes and musicians who say they never saw their kids or took a day off. No TV, no side projects, nothing else competed for their attention. He calls it a magnificent obsession.

His point is that successful people understand singleness of purpose, at least in the beginning.

What would you do if you let yourself be fully focused on one goal?

#ad #success #goals #kevintrudeau

Is it harder to build a business today? Kevin says no.

Kevin Trudeau points to the internet, AI and Amazon, and the many ways to market and sell online without much to start with. Yet he says fewer people act on it.

His reason is initiative. In his view, people who build wealth show it, and those who wait do not.

The tools are there for everyone. What matters is whether you use them.

What is one thing you could start this week?
